approved_note: Drafted by Claude on 14 Oct 2026 for need-led thread choice (Noemi's decision 3 of 14 Oct 2026, after her and a friend's tests of the live site); made-up wording; not yet checked by Noemi. 'judge' lists the words (regular expressions, matched at the start of a word in a thread's lowercased title or post) that show a thread is about the request's need, chosen apart from the engine's own need words (config.NEEDS) so the engine doesn't grade itself. engine/need_eval.py reports, for each answer's first reading (its first 16 threads), how many threads are about the need by title, and by title or post, then the picks and Also worth a look. Added by Claude later on 14 Oct 2026 (the need-quality builder): cases n11-n15, the requests of that builder's before/after table, made-up wording; an optional 'judge_each' ({need: judge words}) judges each need of a request with several apart, so the report counts first-reading threads about every one of them; an optional 'opposite' lists the words of the opposite of what a request asks (a clarifying or detox shampoo for one that isn't drying), so the report counts first-reading threads titled with one and shown products named with one.
